newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-SURREY PLAYER KERSEY DIES AFTER CAR ACCIDENT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SURREY PLAYER KERSEY DIES AFTER CAR ACCIDENT.

text.p: The England cricket team will wear black armbands in the third one-day international against Zimbabwe in Harare on Friday as a mark of respect to Surrey wicket-keeper Graham Kersey, who has died after a car accident.
Kersey, 25, lost his fight for life on New Year's Day after suffering severe head injuries in a car crash in Brisbane, Australia, on December 24.
Kersey, Surrey's player of the year in 1995, was in Australia playing for the Western Suburbs District Cricket Club in Brisbane.
